# counterfactual_replay

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Replays an episode under one declared intervention to compare the observed and counterfactual outcomes.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `replay_id` | `string` | yes | Stable counterfactual replay identity. |
| `source_episode_id` | `string` | yes | Observed episode used as baseline. |
| `intervention_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest of the single counterfactual intervention. |
| `seed` | `string` | yes | Explicit deterministic replay seed. |
| `predicted_outcome` | `string` | yes | Counterfactual outcome produced. |
| `comparison_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest comparing observed and counterfactual traces. |
